newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuania shares gain by close amid slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuania shares gain by close amid slow trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares advanced slightly by the end of trade on Monday but the market was very slow, dealers said.
Official list shares rose 3.46 points to 944.30 points while the broader group A list inched up 2.94 points to 1832.13.
The gains came amid low central market turnover, which slid to 376,000 litas from an already low 457,000 litas.
"I would say that the market was not very strong," said one broker.
The country's second bank Hermis Bank advanced to 215 litas from 212 but saw a mere 6,450 litas turnover.
Largest bank Vilniaus Bank was steady at 243.20 litas in 24,000 litas central market turnover.
Despite the slow trade in the two banks, which led an upturn on the bourse last week, dealers said that attention would once more turn to them.
"These (Vilniaus and Hermis) are the shares that are, lately, always interesting for investors," one broker said.
Shares in Rokishkis Cheese, one of three corporates on the official list, were inactive on the central market and unchanged at 42.00 litas.
However, dealers said there should be some action in the stock after it released news of a first-half profit of 9.467 million litas, versus 1.25 million litas a year earlier, after the market closed.
